relationship_to_v2.disclosure: This is a disclosed prospective expansion after all v2 and V2-A015 results were known.
relationship_to_v2.immutability: Valid v2/V2-A015 cells, outcomes, seeds, raw collections, and denominators are preserved. They are never rewritten, relabeled as v3 primary evidence, or rerun.
relationship_to_v2.arena_boundary: DROID/RoboLab and RoboTwin are separate matched arenas. Raw successes, failure rates, and denominators are never pooled.

common_execution_contract.valid_failure_policy: Every valid behavioral failure remains in its registered denominator.
common_execution_contract.technical_invalidity_policy: Infrastructure-invalid attempts are retained in a separate ledger, repaired only at the identical registered cell, and never counted as behavioral failures or successes.
